question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **more**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **More **means in a greater degree or extent. (अधिक मात्रा या परिमाण में)
 
• The sentence compares the likelihood of misjudging people when we don't know them personally to the situation when we do know them.
 
• "**More**" is the comparative form that appropriately indicates a greater degree of misjudgment.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Most**" suggests the highest degree, which is not the intended comparison in this context.
 
• "**Very much**" is an intensifier but doesn't convey the comparative relationship needed in the sentence.
 
• "**Much**" doesn't indicate a comparative relationship. It simply describes the extent without making a comparison to another situation.
